description: Painted sprite for the patrol knight (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/patrol-knight.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the royal patrol KNIGHT from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the chunky proportions, the big helm and the lance standing upright on the left, not for its style; push the horse head further forward than in the third image. SUBJECT: a royal patrol knight riding a small chunky dark warhorse. HELM: a BIG rounded pale-steel armet helm like the first image: a domed crown and a visor that juts forward to a blunt point at the front, with ONE thin horizontal eye slit and two short vertical breath slits below it, no face visible, a hinge rivet on the side, a thin gold band at the neck. Not a flat-faced bucket helm and no T-shaped opening. The helm is the biggest single shape of the rider: about as wide as his shoulders and about a quarter of the whole figure's height. PLUME: one thick royal-blue plume rising from a gold holder on top of the helm, standing UP and curling FORWARD to the right over the visor, about as tall as the helm; all of it sits above the helm and the front half of the head, nothing behind the back of the helm, so it never touches the lance. ARMOUR: royal-blue breastplate, rounded royal-blue pauldrons with gold rims, steel gauntlets. He sits astride the horse, his near armoured thigh along the horse's back over a royal-blue saddle cloth with gold trim, his whole armoured steel leg hangs clearly down the horse's flank to a gold stirrup under his steel boot. HORSE: short and stocky, seen from the side facing right, a DARK charcoal-grey horse with dark gunmetal barding plates, clearly much darker than the rider's pale steel helm, a black mane, four chunky legs with black hooves, long enough that background shows clearly under its belly. Its neck stretches FORWARD and up to the right, and its head is BIG (about as big as the rider's helm) and sits well IN FRONT of the rider at the far right of the figure, with a wide gap of background between the horse's head and the rider's arm and chest: a clear horse head in profile like a chess knight piece, with a pale steel chanfron plate with a gold edge down its face, a round eye guard around a black dot eye, two pointed ears at the height of the rider's chin, the muzzle pointing right. LANCE: his right fist visibly grips a long lance held straight upright on the far LEFT side of the figure, beside the horse's rump, with a clear gap of background between the lance and the helm and plume: a THICK royal-blue shaft with gold rings, a steel cone guard (vamplate) just ABOVE his fist that opens upward toward the point, and a big steel leaf-shaped spear point at the top, higher than the top of the plume; he holds it near its bottom end, so only a very short butt shows below his fist. His left fist rests low on the saddle pommel in front of his belly, not reaching up to the horse's neck. Side view facing right, the whole horse and rider visible, chunky and big-headed: helm and plume together are about 40% of the figure's height. EYES: one small glinting white dot eye is painted inside the eye slit of the armet, so he clearly looks out to the right. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, polished royal blue with gold trim, pale steel. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
